notes.title: New Loading Screen to skip bugged autosaves
notes.notes:
You can now skip the automatic loading of the previously saved game.
This might be neccessary if your game is for some reason broken and you need to access the main menu again. Of course, bugs shouldn't occur but it always helps to have an option :-)

notes.title: Only five? Five already!
notes.notes:
Lootbox is a niche product and was born out of the need to have a casual dungeon crawler to hand when the bus journey gets too boring.
I used it to fulfil my desire to collect XP and items and develop my player character - without perma-death and without real-time elements*.
Since the game became available for PC and macOS, five people have left a review for Lootbox on Steam and I would like to thank them very much. Every single player is important to me and every reaction to my game - be it positive or negative - is an incentive for me to continue providing good support.
Who knows, maybe the game will even break the 10-review barrier at some point! Until then, I'll keep working on the next update.

P.S. Tip: in ‘hard mode’ many creatures have additional new loot.

(* there are two real-time elements: 1. each level respawns after 10 minutes, 2. when mining ore, the real time is used to calculate how long it will take and how large the amount mined is.

Best regards
Yours, Mario (aka Icetear)

notes.title: v2.0 - the slightly different kind of Early Access
notes.notes:
We are about to release version 2.0. It will take a few months until all the content is complete, but I still have the capacity to integrate your ideas and wishes into the game.
What do you like so far, what don't you like so much, what would you like to change and what would you like to see integrated into the game? Give me your feedback - just click on the speech bubble below this message and you can join the discussion.
Version 2.0 will unlock the second chapter for Lootbox RPG. Now that your ma is back home, the question is whether Pa has gone a little overboard with his call to arms! Can you smooth things over and help his magnificent unholiness back on the right path?

Many new cards, many new items, new spells, new game mechanics and new Minions await you!

Best regards
Mario
Lootbox RPG Developer

notes.title: Lootbox Toolbox
notes.notes:
Ever wondered how the content is created for a game - at least for my game?
Internally I am using a SQLITE Database, which can easily be modified by a tool like "DB Browser for SQLite". But it cannot easily show the relations between items, enemies and scripts.

WARNING! HEAVY SPOILERS AHEAD!

The following screenshots will show you not only my content tool, but of course content. That means you will see enemies, items, spells and other things that you probably haven't discovered yet in the game! If you don't want to be spoiled, stop reading.


So... what is part of my everyday work when being busy with Lootbox?

For example, I need to check if an item is on any loot table, e.g. can actually be found in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/92c5b4f4565cbe9a7defbbde3b4289fa0710fbbb.png[/img]

And on the other hand, I need to check what items a creature can drop - important for balancing out everything:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/3001b79e0b81006466255e8e98e5f1d6e6c1e802.png[/img]

Keeping track of game variables is also important - when is a script fired and how can I tell what an NPC has to say?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/8f5d4ceec3e1408527497b11133dd0deb7cf1d92.png[/img]

Putting it all together in a level overview: what loot can be found in a given dungeon level and what creatures will spawn there?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/d3e6886aa9ef6330cc98996ca547262a53d8aa60.png[/img]

What spells can the player cast? What runes are needed?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/f13e004e8acdc1c49ca5198bd8d365c7cd7fa4d2.png[/img]

Which enemies exist and do they have special abilities?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/230aaae004346325148e3852fd5b16700d5ea239.png[/img]

Where do I use what script?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/bef51ef4829366ba9ce5f93380b16eab42e41a20.png[/img]

Do I have a typo in my script commands or is everything correct?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/7d49e55ff467ca0e7da5cce380ff5d79b707e78f.png[/img]

And last but not least, what Items do I have and are they on any loot table in normal or in hard mode?
If the player can not find it in a chest, loot it from an enemy or craft it - it's probably useless ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937073/5ac98d06208d7377186020aa4cf7fa6a1121cc38.png[/img]

I hope you find this interesting
Kind regards
Mario

notes.title: Lootbox now has an official Wiki!
notes.notes:
By popular demand, I have written a script that transfers all known spells, items and creatures to a wiki.
You will find all items with their most important stats, all spells with their runes and all creatures with their combat stats as well as their loot tables. And yes - the loot chance is included.

Enjoy! And feel free to discuss the wiki. Of course you can register for free and help improving it further.

Here it is: https://wiki.lootbox-rpg.com

kind regards
Mario

notes.title: Patch Notes for 2023-10-19
notes.notes:
- the evil advisor no longer resets the main quest
- fix for inventory overflowing when crafting too much
- fireball now ends your turn

notes.title: Bestiary, Loot and UI changes incoming!
notes.notes:
Here we go:

- added some more informational texts for new players that will help learn the game (e.g. "use the torch in your first hotslot to make light").
- Buff Info now has an "OK" button so that you won't cancel it by accident.
- Added day and night cycle to the overworld.
- Added Defense Potion.
- Adjusted the Grimoire: you will now learn the spell even if you can't cast it yet.
- New: The bestiary keeps track of your kills. Access it from your character screen, Icon in the upper right. Bonus: the more creatures of a certain type you kill, the better your chance of landing a critical hit in the future.
- Changed the loot mechanism. You can now buy silver keys. Silver chests may contain a gold key (also dropped by creatures). On every 5 levels of a dungeon there is a golden chest which requires a gold key. Gold chest loot is better than silver chest loot. You may find a platinum key in a gold chest. Platinum keys open Platinum Chests that can be found on every 5 levels of a HARD MODE dungeon. Platinum Chests contain unique magic items.
- Combining items now takes time.
- Added Elite enemies (to HARD MODE dungeons).
- Added background pictures to the level loading screen.
- Changed the UI (colors and fonts) so that it won't hurt your eyes any longer ;-)
- Added AE damage to "Shatter".
- A Scythe is now required to summon a reaper pet.
- You can now load/save during Work (Mining).
- New Mining progression screen.
- Saving is now enabled in the royal mines.
- Saving is now disabled in hard mode dungeons.
- You can now cast spells from out of your character screen.
- Skill reset now costs gold.
- Many other fixes to known errors.

notes.title: Update 2022-10-18
notes.notes:
With today's patch, you will be able to sort your inventory. Just click and hold the inventory icon on your character screen. Cool, isn't it?
In addition, the zombie mode has gotten some enhancements. You will now try to use magic spells to light your surroundings or open locked chests - if you don't have a torch/lamp/key in your inventory.
And there's another QoL enhancement: a small check is now shown on the level number in the upper right if you've already completed the level before.

Enjoy your crawl!

notes.title: Halloween magic pumpkin event!
notes.notes: Between October 25th and November 1st you have the chance of looting a magic pumpkin from your enemies. After using it, you will get a greatly enhanced autoattack (aka Zombie-Mode) buff that can help you grind your way down to the depths of the Lootbox dungeons. Enjoy your new powers and perhaps save one or two of those pumpkins for later use.

notes.title: We have runes...
notes.notes:
Upon completing your first task you will find yourself thrown into goblin caves. And you will begin to loot runes (and runeboards). What are these for?

Runes can be combined to cast spells. There are three runes that set the power level of a spell, and eight runes that determine the effect of a spell. You will find a magic guide over on the official forums:

https://lootbox-rpg.com/boards/viewtopic.php?t=28

You can even cast a spell on your pet (dog) that will allow it to sell your items while you continue your travel in the dungeons.

notes.title: We have a Quit Game Button!
notes.notes:
You don't have to quit the game via Alt+F4 or Cmd+Q any longer. If you really want to pause from this excellent game, you just can hit "Quit" in the settings menu ;-) Your progress will be saved.
In addition, the cursor was modified, fixing problems when scrolling in your inventory or spell list.
Still working on improving the keyboard commands - but this will take some time...
